title: Puzzle story carousel
description: A centred headline and one-line intro over a row of tall rounded photo cards that runs off the right edge; each photo sits under a soft dark scrim with a small caps tag and a white three-line title at the bottom, and zooms slightly on hover. Two arrow buttons slide the row one card at a time; a 'see all' arrow link sits opposite. On phones one card shows with the next peeking in, arrows and link centred.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows (hydrate visible); the row also scrolls and snaps by swipe or trackpad without it
each card's media slot takes a photo; empty, it shows a muted placeholder
